_comment: Supplementary lead pages for the weekly one-off sweep (weekly-event-prep step 3a). The sweep MUST also run fresh open web searches per metro every populate — this list supplements search, never replaces it (fixed lists go stale). These are LEADS ONLY — never copy event facts from them; verify everything on the organizer/venue/government page per skills/grounded-event-discovery/SKILL.md. Add reliable lead pages as found; remove dead ones.

bay-area.name: Funcheap SF
bay-area.notes: Daily/weekend roundups; strongest single lead source for SF one-offs. Follow through to organizer pages.

bay-area.name: 510 Families
bay-area.notes: East Bay family events; weekend lists.

bay-area.name: Datebook (SF Chronicle) family
bay-area.notes: Paywalled sometimes; headlines still surface event names to verify elsewhere.

bay-area.name: GVRD upcoming events (Vallejo)
bay-area.notes: Official organizer; hosts one-off family events at Children's Wonderland. JS-rendered — plain fetch gets nothing, so kept as a lead (verified via browser) rather than a live source.

bay-area.name: Rhythmix Cultural Works (Alameda)
bay-area.notes: Official 'Rhythmix in the Parks' free family concert series. JS-rendered + TLS-chain issues for plain fetch; past events drop off. Lead only.

los-angeles.name: We Like LA events
los-angeles.notes: General roundups; filter for family fit.

chicago.name: Choose Chicago events
chicago.notes: Official tourism calendar; strong on festivals/parades.

san-diego.name: San Diego Tourism monthly top events
